CustomField.description: The Address value of the Org-Wide Email Address that EmailService.getDefaultOrgWideEmailAddress() should apply when no explicit Org-Wide Email Address Id is provided. Must match the Address field on an existing OrgWideEmailAddress record exactly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The email address of the default Org-Wide Email Address (must match an existing OrgWideEmailAddress record's Address field).
CustomField.label: Default Org Wide Email Address
